title: Super Pack Mystica Legacy Carbon Hybrid Blue 2024 - Mystica
description:
SUPER PACK MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024 - One of the packs with the best quality-price ratio on the market. The Mystica racket is without a doubt a complete racket, in an oversize format and in 3K carbon. Take the leap to the track with the SUPER PACK MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024, a perfect combination for those looking for performance and complete equipment. Includes padel backpack, 10 overgrips, 1 can of balls and 1 protector.

The Mystica Legacy Carbon Hybrid Blue 2024 is a hybrid racket that offers an excellent balance between control and power. Its 3K carbon construction provides great resistance and a solid response to each hit, making it a very versatile option to face any game situation.
